newsitem.title: GERMANY: Allianz cannot confirm reports of Chinese licence.
newsitem.headline: Allianz cannot confirm reports of Chinese licence.

text.p: German insurance group Allianz AG said on Tuesday it could not confirm reports from Winterthur Insurance Co that Allianz will be the next foreign insurer to get a licence to operate in China.
"We would be delighted if it were the case that we will be next to get a licence to business in China, but we cannot confirm the story," said a spokesman for Allianz.
Earlier an official from Winterthur said: "I think Allianz will be the next. We have knowledge about the fact that Allianz will be the next."
Swiss insurer Winterthur said earlier in the day that Chinese authorities had granted it a definitive licence for non-life insurance business in the Shanghai region.
